name: Sahereh
overview: This series tells the story of a successful businessman named Ehsan who seemingly has everything, but his carefree life is turned upside down by a sudden and unexpected event. Faced with the knowledge that his life is about to end (he has an illness with less than two months to live), he tries to find a new meaning for life and death in the time he has left. Along the way, he encounters people with different perspectives—from worldly people to service people—who change his view of the world.
